name: API3

chains.note: Other-chain deployments not checked; Ethereum token holds the 200M total supply per totalSupply()

scope_note: Native ERC-20 utility/governance token, not wrapped/staked/stable/RWA/leveraged; listed on Binance/Coinbase/Kraken/OKX since 2020-21 (>90 days).

D1.value: Top-10 non-excluded = 72.4% of circulating if the Api3Pool staking contract (68.63M, 41.67%) counts as one holder; 30.7% if it is set aside as an aggregate of stakers. The §3 D exclusions do not cover staking contracts, and per-staker balances inside the pool were not read.

D2.value: Safe 0xb7fa2Cb302C5dC127e61F27b92beC411cbf0AE4A holds 17,503,073 API3 = 10.63% of circulating (164.70M), above the 10% limit. It is a 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe v1.5.0 with no guard, funded on 2026-11-04 in the Primary Proposal 17 execution tx (9,929,000 minted plus 6,083,874 from the DAO Agent 0xD9F8...04Ae). That makes it a DAO treasury/insider wallet, not a vesting or timelock contract with an on-chain schedule.
D2.source: Blockscout holders + /addresses/0xb7fa.../token-transfers (tx 0xa0e8b43cb7e1...); eth_call getThreshold()=3, getOwners()=5 owners, VERSION()=1.5.0 via ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com

D3.value: 23.69% of circulating: treasury Safe 10.63% + unidentified >=2% wallets counted as insiders under D5 (0xA15b 7.00%, 0xB0bf 3.53%, 0x1dac 2.53%). Even if 0xA15b turns out to be an exchange, the total is 16.69%, still near the line, and the D2 fail stands either way.

D4.value: Not run: stopped at the D2 hard fail.

D5.value: 3 non-excluded wallets at >=2% have no explorer label: 0xA15b41801fb5cD518b7Bb4b59EC31b007EA397B4 (7.00%), 0xB0bfC664b44331a8a9c9F6057dF4784E89cd898E (3.53%), 0x1dacb40d74C601e7aD4919dBf00CFE7D36EDfEeb (2.53%). The prior analysis says 0xB0bf and 0x1dac were funded from Coinbase 10, and 0xA15b looked like an exchange; neither was confirmed.
